FX-BUBBLE-001.says: As added: 100 bubbles of size 1 (on a picture 32 high, between half a pixel and a pixel and a half in radius), speed 0.5, wobble 5 at once a second, Inverse, Fade Inwards: a scatter of tiny faint dots on clear, the picture itself gone.

FX-BUBBLE-002.says: Six bubbles of size 8, 3 to 10 pixels in radius, each the picture under it turned over and spread, clear in the middle, rising: frame 12 is half a second later.

FX-BUBBLE-003.says: World reflection: each bubble the picture round it, upright.

FX-BUBBLE-007.says: Fade Outwards: clear at the rim, solid in the middle.

FX-BUBBLE-008.says: Speed -2: falling, half the picture a second at pace 1.

FX-BUBBLE-009.says: Speed 0 and wobble 0: still, so frame 12 is frame 0.

FX-BUBBLE-011.says: Speed 0, wobble frequency 0: the wobble holds where it started, so frame 6 is frame 0.

FX-BUBBLE-020.says: FX-BUBBLE-002 moved 3 pixels right: the same bubbles, moved, cut at the layer's edge.

FX-BUBBLE-021.says: FX-BUBBLE-002 at 30 frames a second: frame 12 is two fifths of a second in, not a half.
